rows.note: This is the all-purpose term for someone commanding a military or naval organization.

example.english: The commander directed the soldiers on the front line.
example.traditional: 指揮官喺前線指揮成隊士兵。
example.jyutping: zi2 fai1 gun1 hai2 cin4 sin3 zi2 fai1 sing4 deoi6 si6 bing1

rows.note: Use this for a senior military commander or the commander of a named military formation.

example.english: The commander ordered the whole army to retreat immediately.
example.traditional: 司令下令全軍即刻撤退。
example.jyutping: si1 ling6 haa6 ling6 cyun4 gwan1 zik1 hak1 cit3 teoi3

rows.note: Use this for the person leading and directing a group, team, or party.

example.english: The commander led us on a hike and explained the scenery along the way.
example.traditional: 領隊帶我哋行山，仲一路講解沿途風景。
example.jyutping: ling5 deoi6 daai3 ngo5 dei6 haang4 saan1 zung6 jat1 lou6 gong2 gaai2 jyun4 tou4 fung1 ging2

rows.note: Use this specifically for the naval rank between lieutenant commander and captain.

example.english: The commander met reporters at the base today.
example.traditional: 海軍中校今日喺基地接見記者。
example.jyutping: hoi2 gwan1 zung1 haau6 gam1 jat6 hai2 gei1 dei6 zip3 gin3 gei3 ze2
